items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I knew Joe Mar[shall], I called him up. He says, come on down. So I went down to see what the street was.

ctx.x: So you didn't have anything pending or anything.

Nothing. I was in bad shape. We just had to scrape. So I went down and put my card in, but I knew Joe Mar[shall], I called him up. He says, come on down. So I went down to see what the street was. And this was my first shot.
